layout_source.limits: Community reverse-engineering; validated here only by container size, slot digest, AES block shape, duplicate-name agreement, and conservative field ranges.

save_location.limits: Auto-detection does not scan drives, AppData, arbitrary backups, or other FromSoftware game directories.

container.digest: MD5(encrypted user data) stored in slot header

container_and_slots.validation: Exact size and per-slot digest; empty slots are represented without character claims.

character_identity.validation: UTF-16LE names at 0x108 and 0x18C must both decode to printable, non-empty, identical strings.

stats_and_level.validation: Stat bytes must be 1..99; level must be 1..713; class id must be 0..9.

humanity.validation: Offset is source-documented, but exposed only with full identity/stat validation.

currency.reason: Current souls/currency offset is not validated for DSR Remastered.

inventory.reason: Inventory record boundaries and item-handle semantics are not validated for DSR Remastered.

owned_items.reason: Inventory ownership cannot be established without a validated DSR inventory layout.

progress.reason: Boss, bonfire, and event-flag offsets are not validated for DSR Remastered.

completion.reason: Completion requires validated inventory and event-flag layouts.

achievement_unlocks.reason: Achievement unlock state is platform-account data and is not validated in DSR saves; static checklist labels remain available.

failure_policy.malformed_or_wrong_game: Raise SaveReadError with an explanatory message; never return guessed fields.
failure_policy.missing_optional_crypto: Raise SaveUnsupportedError; never inspect encrypted bytes as plaintext.
failure_policy.unsupported_category: Return supported:false with reason and evidence.
failure_policy.mutations: No mutation, decryption output writing, repair, re-encryption, or checksum changes are implemented.
